name: bellonas-runestone-banish-buffs-a-weapon-and-adds-a-durability-counter
notes: The generator filed this printed ACTIVATED ability in the play-time $cardActivatedAbilities table, so the field click was routed through ActivateCard (the item treated as a card being played): the effect ran but the printed REST / banish-self / sacrifice cost was never paid and the item could be re-used for free every time. Registered as a field activation ($activateAbilityAbilities in Custom/GameLogic.php; ActivatedAbilityCost pays the cost) and the play-time body neutralized in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php.

rulesClauses: Banish Bellona's Runestone: Target weapon you control gets +2 POWER until end of turn. Put a durability counter on that weapon.

engineBug.summary: Bellona's Runestone could be used repeatedly without banishing itself.
